name: Kagi Translate
desc: Private translator for text, voice and images in 248 languages.
desc_zh: 支持 248 种语言的私密文本、语音和图片翻译器
solves: Machine translators flatten tone and keep your text forever. Kagi Translate lets you set formality and voice, then forgets the request.
solves_zh: 机器翻译会把语气磨平，还会永久留下你的原文。Kagi Translate 可以设定正式程度和语气，翻译完也不留记录。
best_for: A customer replied in a language you read slowly and the tone matters more than the words.
best_for_zh: 客户用一门你读得慢的语言回复，而语气比字面意思更要紧。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://kagi.com/changelog and https://blog.kagi.com/ , then the Kagi produc）。 Launched 2024-11-07, before the discovery window, but the ledger holds only Kagi Assistant for this vendor so it is missing by definition. Native Android and iOS apps followed on 2026-01-29 (changelog 'Kagi Translate on Android & iOS: translate anything, anywhere'); same product, not a separate entry. It moved to a freemium model with a standalone $8/month plan on 2026-09-10 (https://blog.kagi.com/translate-is-back). No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.kagi.com/kagi-translate
